name: Rime's Wrath

angles.text: As a Mage, you study the shaping of ice magic, and wild minor ice elementals show elemental forces in an unruly form.
As a Shaman, you seek to understand and commune with elemental spirits. These hostile ice spirits cannot be calmed, so you must quell them by force.

faq.answer: You are asked to destroy minor ice elementals that threaten the area. No peaceful way to calm them is known, so force is needed to keep others safe.
The minor ice elementals have grown too dangerous to leave unchecked. With no known way to calm them, you are asked to destroy them to protect the area.
faq.q: Why do the minor ice elementals need to be destroyed?

faq.answer: Someone concerned for the area's safety hoped to calm the spirits but did not know how. You are asked to destroy the elementals before they can harm anyone.
faq.q: Who requests the destruction of the elementals?

faq.answer: Those who sent you do not know how to calm the elementals. Without a way to soothe their aggression, you are asked to destroy them.
faq.q: Could the elementals have been dealt with peacefully?

aliases: how strong are minor ice elementals
faq.answer: Minor ice elementals are spirits of elemental frost. Their cold and aggression make them dangerous to travelers and local inhabitants if left roaming freely.
faq.q: What kind of creatures are minor ice elementals?

faq.answer: After you defeat ten minor ice elementals, the immediate danger is quelled. Those who sent you regret that violence was needed, but leaving the spirits unchecked was too risky.
faq.q: What is the outcome of dealing with the elementals?

sections.body: Minor ice elementals have gathered nearby, and their biting cold puts passersby at risk. You are asked to contain the danger before the spirits can harm anyone.
sections.title: A Bitter Manifestation

sections.body: Those who hoped to calm the frost spirits do not know how. As the elementals grow more dangerous, you are asked to destroy them and protect the surrounding territory.
sections.title: Beyond Placation

summary: Minor ice elementals roam the area, and no peaceful way to calm them is known. You are asked to destroy them before they can harm anyone.
